## Withheld or unresolved materials

No license election is made and no attribution is invented. The following are not represented by a complete package-matched notice here:

- **zlib-ng / zlib-compatible code:** Qt copy identity is unresolved; CPython `1.3.1` does not establish a zlib-ng release. A version-tagged zlib-ng 2.2.4 license candidate is included for reference only; no candidate text is asserted applicable to the binaries.- **liblzma/XZ Utils:** exact embedded version/license vintage is unresolved; no license is selected.
- **libtiff and libwebp:** package versions and complete applicable notice/patent materials are unresolved.
- **PDFium / Qt PDF:** snapshot and complete transitive attribution set unresolved; no guessed PDFium or dependency notice is included.
- **Microsoft VC++ runtime:** applicable terms and version skew unresolved; no Microsoft terms are reproduced.
- **OpenSSL NOTICE:** the inspected 3.5.9 tag has no file named NOTICE; its `ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md` is included separately. The binary source archive is unknown. Apache-2.0 section 4(d) conditions reproduction of a NOTICE file on a NOTICE file being included with the Work; none is fabricated.
- **FreeType/Zstandard:** both upstream alternatives are included, neither is selected. FreeType exact embedded version/election remains unknown; Zstandard version 1.5.7 is reported, but downstream election is not recorded.
- **Qt/PySide licensing:** remains separate under `../qt/`; project-level LGPL/GPL texts were not modified. Qt vendor pages here do not prove exact Qt 6.12.0 binary composition.
- **Other candidates:** TinyCBOR, MD4C, double-conversion, libpsl/Public Suffix List, Brotli code, and PDFium dependencies without package evidence are not attributed as present.

## Integrity and interpretation

The table covers every file in this directory except this `MANIFEST.md`; its own final size and SHA-256 are reported separately. Source URLs identify retrieval locations, not proof the same revision was linked into the Windows binary. Review the inventories and resolve evidence gaps before any release use.
